status: PASS for selected operator configuration in local and dev HTTP. TLS/update/host workers and live Firebase remain pending.
scope: Native configuration facade/adapters, selected workspace and six UI sections: branding, API URL, privacy contact, administrator emails, social links and Firebase. No Java change, company Registry, payment or community models.

checks.name: Focused frontend tests
assertions: Validation and normalization
Local seed does not overwrite edited settings
One IndexedDB hydration and persisted reload
Operator-only data excluded from public projection
Local credential presence only; raw credentials never persisted
Firebase changes invalidate verification; unverified activation refused
Stale/closed-popup Firebase results ignored; browser readiness lease released
Write-only credential and destination token drafts cleared on close

checks.name: Operator browser configuration
assertions: Dedicated operator role selection and owned session
Six retained sections
Close discards unsaved edits after the next native load completes
Branding save and header propagation survive reload
Partial privacy contact disables save; complete contact normalizes and persists
Administrator emails deduplicate/normalize and persist
API URL normalizes and persists
Unverified Firebase activation unavailable
Seven rendered contextual guide targets
No local Java API calls and no browser errors
Logout denies the operator route

checks.name: HTTP authority and private data
assertions: Member GET and PUT configuration return 403
Public configuration omits administrator list and private Firebase object
Operator response contains credential presence rather than raw secrets
Fixture restores settings through the owning endpoint and exact stored snapshot; removes only owned users/sessions

checks.name: Responsive layout
checks.note: Screenshots inspected; mobile has no horizontal overflow. Branding-logo upload is selected from the native ImageCarousel but not separately exercised here.

performance.implementation: On-demand configuration load and native save response reconciliation. Local bootstrap seeds once and repository hydrates once. No new polling loop or Java/database query.
performance.limits: Single request and diagnostic CPU sample, not a matched comparison or performance-parity claim. One compiler and one application stack; local watcher stopped before frontend-sync restarted.
